I've used the stuff on Clker in the past for various projects and modified them to fit my needs.

One thing I like about Clker is they often have several resolutions to pick from in PNG format and also have SVG's available for certain things.

Downside is they don't have many stock photos, it's mostly vector graphics / clipart.

Just a heads up, just because its online and labeled public domain (no one owns the copyright anymore) does not give certainty that it is indeed public domain. When you find something you like do a reverse image search and see if its hosted on a site were someone would likely claim copyright. Alternatively look closely at images that are labeled Creative Commons, this license allows non-commercial use so long as certain guidelines are followed.
